comment: labmon2 DUAL-ZONE MONITOR-FALLBACK held-out benchmark (16 scenarios, 4 per sun rank). Two INDEPENDENT zones, each with a primary lamp (+400, Causes, rank3), a monitor (+200, Causes, rank2 only) and a sun-mediated blind (+0.50*Sun). NO spotlight, NO cross-zone spill. Targets Z1=bright(3) AND Z2=bright(3). Physics: Zi = 25 + (ZiLight?400) + (ZiMonitor?200) + (ZiBlinds?0.50*Sun). The monitor ALONE never reaches rank3 (25+200=225=rank2); at LOW sun the lamp is the ONLY rank-3 lever. At sun=900 opening a blind alone gives 475=rank3 at ZERO energy = the cheap optimum. Sun in {0,100,400,900} via bounds [50,200,600].
description: sun=0, all off -> both lamps on (monitor 225=rank2 insufficient, blind adds 0)
sun=0, both at target via lamps -> hold
sun=0, Z1 monitor-only rank2 (225), Z2 at target -> turn Z1 lamp on (monitor cannot reach rank3)
sun=0, both bright but monitors ALSO on -> turn monitors off (redundant energy)
sun=1, all off -> both lamps on
sun=1, Z1 at target, Z2 monitor+blind rank2 (275) -> turn Z2 lamp on (still short of goal)
sun=1, monitors-only rank2 (225) -> insufficient: turn both lamps on
sun=2, all off -> both lamps on (blind only 225=rank2, insufficient)
sun=2, Z1 blind-only rank2 (225), Z2 at target -> turn Z1 lamp on (or add monitor to blind for rank3)
sun=2, both at target via monitor+blind (25+200+200=425) -> hold

comment: === SUNSHINE RANK 3 (sun=900) — a single blind = 475 at ZERO energy ===
description: sun=3, all off -> OPEN both blinds (475 each, zero energy) is the cheap optimum
sun=3, both bright via lamps (energy-costly) -> switch to blinds to save energy
sun=3, Z1 blind open (475), Z2 lamp on -> open Z2 blind and drop its lamp
sun=3, both at target via blinds only -> hold (already zero-energy optimum)
